text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Sprinters Stakes. Seeking
the Pearl
has been preparing for this
ever since she gave up
on running in a
European G1 this year.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha. It's time to go to war, Trainer! This
will be a
battle for the top!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Taiki is the strongest racer here, and the
sheer
amount of her fans says it all. But
even so...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural for a world champion to
be
favored. Seeking the Pearl and I, on
the other
hand...
choice_data_list: ああ、まだ決まったわけじゃない
うん、まだ決まったわけじゃない
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, it's not set in stone yet.
Yeah, it's not set in stone yet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Well, we've been lying in ambush. After
much
deliberation, we decided to spend
the entirety of
summer training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, we'll find out if that was the right

decision.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Maybe... No, that's not quite the right
response.
choice_data_list: 君こそ絶対に最速だ、パール
貴方こそ絶対に最速だよ、パール
choice_data_list_en: You are definitely the fastest, Pearl.
You are definitely the fastest, Pearl.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I'll show everyone just how
fast the
running of someone who
overcame her own
destiny can be!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Welcome to the world of sprinting, Taiki! This is my playground!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You look like you're bursting with
confidence.
Did winning a European G1
really have such a
massive effect on
you?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: It sure did!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But I feel a strength in you that I didn't
feel from
the racers I competed against
in France!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both Taiki Shuttle's body and instincts
have
grown sharper and stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Many people have failed to notice
Seeking the
Pearl's growth, but Taiki
Shuttle caught on to it
right away.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I've gone so far as to shun my own
destiny, all so I
could win against you
today.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Show me all you've got, Taiki! Show me,
so I can
best you with my own superior
strength.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Brace yourself, for today is the day
I will
shine brilliantly for the world to
see!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She who conquered the world and she
who should
have conquered it instead.
Today, they face each
other anew.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This 1,200-meter race will be a quick
one. And
so, the curtain rises on this

blink-and-you'll-miss-it race out here in
this
eastern corner of the world.
